C260.notes: SER EU-SU-001. Photo confirmed · Joseph: year 1931 (was easy to misread as 1951). Value side big 3 · КОПЕЙКИ · wheat ears · 1931 (arms / hammer-sickle reverse not shown). First 3 kopecks in the vault — sits above the later 1-kopek twins C042/C044 / EU-SU-003/004. Early Stalin-era aluminum-bronze small change — tram / store / market odd-kopecks while the first Five-Year Plan years were still grinding. SER siblings: EU-SU-002…004. USSR flips now 4.
C260.story: A 1931 3 kopecks from USSR. The obverse shows USSR arms hammer & sickle; the reverse shows big 3; КОПЕЙКИ, wheat ears, 1931. Struck in aluminum-bronze / brass.

C261.notes: SER EU-SU-002. Photo confirmed · user shorthand 1932. Worker with hammer left · shield 15 · КОП. · date 1932 above · rim СОЮЗ СОВЕТСКИХ СОЦИАЛИСТИЧЕСКИХ РЕСПУБЛИК (arms reverse not shown). First 15 kopecks in the vault — year twin lane with C260 / EU-SU-001 (1931 3 Kop); both early-1930s Soviet minors before the later 1-kopek twins C042/C044. Second Five-Year Plan pocket weight — tram / store / factory canteen odd-change. USSR flips now 4.
C261.story: A 1932 15 kopecks from USSR. The obverse shows USSR arms; the reverse shows worker with hammer left; shield 15, КОП., date, rim СОЮЗ СОВЕТСКИХ СОЦИАЛИСТИЧЕСКИХ РЕСПУБЛИК. Struck in cupronickel.
